sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2005 Ford GT, finished in Midnight Blue Metallic with an Ebony interior, and will be displayed live at Willow Springs Reimagined as part of the Cars & Bids Willow Springs Collection. This Ford GT is owned by journalist and Cars & Bids founder Doug DeMuro, and associated videos are viewable below. This GT is offered with a clean Carfax vehicle history report and has reportedly been registered to two owners in California since new. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this GT is a three-option car, equipped with the optional 18-inch front and 19-inch rear BBS forged wheels, painted brake calipers, and painted racing stripes. Additional notable factory equipment includes leather upholstery, carbon fiber seats, and air conditioning. Notable modifications reported by the seller include an SCT ECU tune, a smaller supercharger pulley, a Ford Racing exhaust, a Ford Racing short shifter, an Alpine head unit, and Ford GT designer Camilo Pardo's signature in the engine bay. Ford rekindled its rivalry with Ferrari when it rebooted the GT for 2005. Inspired by the Le Mans-winning GT40, the limited-production coupe represented America in the supercar segment with a heritage-laced design, a driver-focused interior, and a mid-mounted supercharged V8. Around 4,000 units were built, and Ford retired the GT nameplate until it launched the second-generation model for 2017. Power comes from a 5.4-liter supercharged V8, rated at 550 horsepower and 500 lb-ft of torque in stock form. Due to the modifications performed to this GT, it may produce more power, but a dyno sheet was not provided to confirm. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.

sections.Seller Notes: Due to the modifications performed to this GT, it may not pass emissions testing in some states. As always, it's the buyer's responsibility to perform all due diligence regarding registering this Ford in their respective state prior to placing a bid. The seller states that a full-body paint protection film was applied to this Ford GT in October 2018.
